0.17.3: Cross-machine messaging: agents on separate PCs can now message each other over Tailscale, once their machines are linked.
The plugin now includes a built-in usage guide, and its tool descriptions explain the cross-machine feature.
From now on you are told what changed after each update, and once a day whether a newer version is available. Nothing updates on its own.
0.17.2: After a plugin update the background relay that carries messages between machines is replaced as soon as any session reconnects, so messages arriving right after an update keep their send time.
0.17.1: Messages now show when they were sent, in your local time. Message ids are stamped in UTC so machines in different time zones stay in order.
After updating, restart every session on the machine. A session left on an older version can make since-filters, unread badges and reaction wakes skip messages for a few hours.
0.17.0: First version of cross-machine messaging over Tailscale: direct messages, group chats, mentions, reactions and deletions work between linked machines.
If a machine is unreachable the message is queued and you are told why, in the send result and by a message from comms-relay after a minute.
